svg.title: Connected board assembly — Ing. Alex M. Rivera

g.text: Base: THT parts and male headers on TOP; all SMD and solder joints underneath.
Upper: XIAO + ADS1115 on TOP; female SMD sockets, C5 and cable lands underneath.
B.Cu only for routing and fabrication. No F.Cu tracks, copper zones or vias.
14 mm PCB top-to-top spacing; approximately 35.6 mm total including 1 mm below base.
35 mm fit is unverified. Allow 36–38 mm before lid and cable-bend allowances.
Stock THT tails shown untrimmed. Select compatible long pins; support both boards and ADC.
USB: phone → cut cable → base J2 → J4 → upper J5 → USB-C male pigtail → XIAO.
Use a resistor-free pigtail with active CC continuity and the XIAO onboard termination.
Supplied ADS model prints A3/A2/A1/A0; verify the real module before manufacture.
